analyst_view.overall: Freiburg (14th, 6 pts) host Twente (3rd, 9 pts) in a game that matters for both: Freiburg are close to the top eight and Twente want to stay in it. Freiburg are third in the Bundesliga after five straight league wins, the latest 1-0 at Elversberg on Saturday, and the club says everyone came back from international duty unhurt; only Florent Muslija is out, and the numbers count him. Twente have won all three league-phase games and are without goalkeeper Lars Unnerstall, Max Bruns and Filip Thorvaldsen (all counted), with defender Stav Lemkin doubtful after a long layoff. Freiburg usually rotate between Bundesliga and Europe, which is part of their ratings, and the numbers' momentum already counts Twente's hot attacking run and Freiburg's stingy recent defending. No referee is named yet.
